method: Independent Python stdlib CSV/OOXML parsing, not production execution. Sum explicit ages 6..17 and both sexes across all Incheon dong records. Retain the published post-reorganisation school summary, not the pre-reorganisation table or individual-school records. Compare declared snapshots; do not estimate capacity or a same-date population.

sources.coverageEvidence: All 162 selected administrative-office records, including four branch offices, reproduce the publisher's July 2026 age-6..17 totals for all 11 districts and Incheon overall. This is a source/revision-specific reconciliation, not a generic rule that branch offices are always disjoint.

areaMapping.officialEvidence: Act 21734, promulgated 2026-06-02, changes Incheon Seo-gu to Seohae-gu effective 2026-07-01. The enactment reason separately identifies the Seo-gu / Geomdan-gu split. The workbook expressly labels this second table as geography after the 2026-07-01 reorganisation.
areaMapping.interpretation: A source-specific mapping of the post-split school summary label only, inferred from its explicit geography header and the official renaming act. It does not equate pre-split Seo-gu with Seohae-gu or prove unchanged dong boundaries.

requiredLimitations: Population is a July 31 snapshot; school enrolment was surveyed April 1 and recategorised using July 1 geography, not observed again in July.
The school published total includes kindergarten, special and other school categories beyond ages 6..17; elementary/middle/high subtotals remain separate.
Branch counts and branch enrolment remain separately published columns; trustee and other subgroup columns are not silently added.
Enrolment and resident school-age population have different populations; neither is school capacity.
Pre-reorganisation school districts cannot be joined to July population by name alone.
The source-specific post-reorganisation 서구 label mapping is not a general area identity or temporal crosswalk.
